description: Cart clearing fails while other cart operations can still work.

incident.title: Customers cannot clear their shopping carts
incident.description: Removing all cart items fails, and some customers still see items after placing an order. Investigate the cause; do not assume checkout itself failed.

diagnostic_reference.observable_mechanism: Cart clearing fails while establishing storage connectivity, with EnsureRedisConnected or a corresponding cart-storage connection exception.
diagnostic_reference.propagation: The direct clear operation fails; linked checkout requests can still complete despite a later EmptyCart failure. Residual items require linked same-cart readback.
exclusions: Do not generalize to all cart operations or total Valkey outage.
Do not invent a target hostname or final cart contents absent evidence.
